emotionalEating.title: Your Eating Story
emotionalEating.empathyBanner: Most apps track what you eat. Habeat also cares about why. A few quick questions help us understand your eating story.
emotionalEating.relationshipQuestion: How would you describe your relationship with food?
emotionalEating.unsureDescription: Habeat will help you notice patterns over time. No pressure to have it figured out now.
emotionalEating.triggersQuestion: What tends to make you reach for food?

diet.title: Diet Goal
diet.description: Select your health and fitness goal.

dietaryRestrictions.title: Dietary Restrictions
dietaryRestrictions.description: Select any dietary restrictions or preferences (optional).
dietaryRestrictions.question: Any dietary restrictions?

fastingHours.title: Fasting Schedule
fastingHours.description: Configure your intermittent fasting window (8-16 hours).
fastingHours.startTimeHint: When do you start your fasting period?

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.description: Help us personalize your plans by telling us a bit about yourself.

fitness.title: Fitness Goal
fitness.description: Help us tailor your plans by letting us know your weekly workout frequency.
fitness.question: How many times a week do you plan to work out?

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Select all that apply to personalize your meal and workout plans.

errors.tooLong: Keep it under {{max}} characters — just the food name works best.
errors.noLetters: Please use words, not only symbols or numbers.
errors.listFull: That's the maximum of {{maxItems}} items. Remove one to add another.

myDishes.title: What do you usually cook?
myDishes.description: Pick the dishes you already make most weeks. We build your plan around them, so it fits your life instead of replacing it.
myDishes.hint: Tap the ones you make, or add your own. You can always change this later.
myDishes.progress: {{count}} added — a few more and we can build your week around them.
myDishes.enough: {{count}} dishes — that's plenty to work with.

cooking.title: How much cooking are you up for?
cooking.description: We'll only plan meals you'd actually make. You can change this any time.
cooking.changeLater: Not sure? Pick the one that fits a normal weekday — you can change it in your profile.

beginner.label: I keep it simple
beginner.description: Assembly, one pan or one tray. Few ingredients, nothing to juggle.

home-cook.label: I'm a comfortable home cook
home-cook.description: Everyday cooking — sautéing, roasting, a simple sauce, a couple of pans.

confident.label: I love to cook
confident.description: Bring on multi-step dishes — marinades, braises, baking, real sauces.
